description: NeuroLLM MVP benchmark: spec section 9 categories. `expected_answer`/`match_type` are only populated for objectively-checkable categories (factual, mathematical, logical) so /api/experiment/benchmark can score real accuracy; every other category is left null rather than guessed, per the project's no-fabricated-numbers rule (see data/README.md).
